detail.longDescription:
WiFi Lab is a professional wireless network analysis and optimization tool designed to help you gain in-depth insight into the current Wi-Fi environment around you. Whether at home or in the office, it accurately diagnoses common issues such as weak signals, lag, and latency, allowing you to easily take control of your network status and eliminate tedious troubleshooting.

It can display in real time detailed information about the currently connected Wi-Fi network, including SSID, BSSID, channel, and encryption method. Signal strength monitoring dynamically tracks changes in each network's signal level. The coverage mapping feature generates spatial heatmaps of Wi-Fi signal distribution, and the speed test measures both upload and download .

Whether you are a home network user, IT operations staff, or network engineer, WiFi Lab can be your reliable assistant. With intuitive operation and professional-grade data, it makes complex network diagnostics simple and efficient, helping you enjoy stable,  wireless connectivity .
